title: Accept labeled integer values outside declared intervals
problem: Integer descriptors reject an explicitly labeled value when it falls outside the descriptor's numeric intervals.
reproduce: Create a UInt16 descriptor with interval 2..8 and label special=15; the baseline rejects 15 even though it is declared.
acceptance: Interval members and exact labeled values are accepted, while an unlabeled value outside every interval remains invalid.
repair: After checking numeric intervals, compare the candidate against every declared label value and add focused descriptor assertions.

selection.reason: The open owner-described defect has exact hardware-free acceptance, no competing PR, and a minimal shared-template repair.

verification.limitations: BCL compiles and runs the real Descriptor implementation with warnings as errors. The complete OLA suite is left to upstream CI.
verification.ownerCheck: Parse or construct an integer field whose named value lies outside its ranges and confirm OLA accepts that label value while rejecting an undeclared out-of-range value.
